title: App Vault
summary: App Vault is a one-stop spot for all most frequently used features and info.
description:
With App Vault, you can access useful tools, widgets, and information with just one swipe. Shortcuts, weather, calendar widgets, news, and more are available in one place — no need to open multiple apps.

App Vault provides a simple and clean experience with customization options, helping you quickly access the information and services you need. You can also launch your frequently used apps directly from App Vault.

This version of App vault is compatible with MIUI 13 and later.

App Finder

App Finder is an integrated SDK capability within App Vault that provides a system-wide on-device search experience for supported Xiaomi devices. It enables users to quickly discover local content across apps, files, and messages through a unified search interface.

Users can actively search for content on their devices, and relevant results are displayed based on their queries. All search processing is performed locally on-device to provide a fast and private search experience.

On HyperOS OS1 and OS2, App Finder SDK is integrated into App Vault to provide this system search capability.

Shortcuts
Open your favorite and frequently-used apps with a single tap.

Weather
Check the current weather and multi-day forecast at a glance.

News
View headlines and stories from around the world, including sports, technology, entertainment, and business.

Health
Record and view your personal health data with ease for a fitter, healthier life.

Discover what you can do with App Vault!
